args.query:
-- Check what data currently exists in measurements table
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_measurements FROM measurements;

-- Check if pilot_sessions data exists in measurements
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pilot_sessions;

-- Check if pilot session IDs S101, S102, S103 exist in measurements
SELECT session_id FROM measurements WHERE session_id IN ('S101', 'S102', 'S103');

-- Transform pilot_sessions data and insert into measurements
-- Mapping: protocol_note -> notes
INSERT INTO measurements (session_id, participant_id, condition, cognitive_score, reaction_ms, recorded_at, status, notes)
SELECT 
    session_id,
    participant_id,
    condition,
    cognitive_score,
    reaction_ms,
    recorded_at,
    status,
    protocol_note AS notes
FROM pilot_sessions
WHERE session_id IN ('S101', 'S102', 'S103');

-- Verify the insertion - check pilot_sessions data in measurements
SELECT m.session_id, m.participant_id, m.cognitive_score, m.reaction_ms, m.status, m.notes
FROM measurements m
WHERE m.session_id IN ('S101', 'S102', 'S103')
ORDER BY m.session_id;

-- Verify the insertion - count total measurements now
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_measurements FROM measurements;

-- Check total count including all measurements
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM measurements WHERE session_id LIKE 'S%' ORDER BY session_id DESC LIMIT 20;

-- List some measurement sessions to verify the schema
SELECT DISTINCT session_id FROM measurements ORDER BY session_id DESC LIMIT 10;

-- Check all session IDs in measurements with higher numbers to find S101-S103
SELECT session_id FROM measurements WHERE session_id >= 'S090' ORDER BY session_id DESC LIMIT 30;

-- View all measurements to see the full picture
SELECT session_id, notes FROM measurements WHERE session_id LIKE 'S%' ORDER BY session_id DESC LIMIT 20;
